title: Station Readings
prompt:
Design a fictional data-operations example for this task: 
          Four stations report different units. Select a station to read its own operating context.
         A narrow station rail controls a dark instrument panel; a full-width exception strip closes the operational sequence. Preserve the supplied data, keyboard controls, recovery actions and local-only behavior. Use Office Code Pro and a #EED6B3 page with #713B0F accents.
